'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Allen Gaible DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
